events.label: Intermittent body swaps; notes left for each other
events.description: Taki, a Tokyo boy, and Mitsuha, a girl from a mountain town, start waking up in each other's bodies a few days a week - leaving notes and phone diaries to manage each other's lives.

events.label: Swaps stop; Taki seeks Mitsuha
events.description: The swaps stop as abruptly as they began - and Taki, unable to explain his restlessness, sets out for Mitsuha's town to find her in person.

events.label: Taki learns Itomori destroyed by Comet Tiamat in 2013
events.description: On the train to Itomori, Taki learns the town no longer exists: it was destroyed three years ago when the comet Tiamat broke apart overhead.

events.label: Taki drinks kuchikamizake at Goshintai; returns to Mitsuha's body
events.description: On the mountain shrine, Taki drinks Mitsuha's kuchikamizake - her ritual sake - and falls through her memories into her body one more time, on the morning of the comet three years ago.

events.label: In Mitsuha's body: substation sabotage and emergency broadcast with Tessie and Sayaka
events.description: In Mitsuha's body, Taki drafts a rescue: blow the substation, trigger a false emergency broadcast, and drive the whole town up the mountain beyond the comet's path - with her friends Tessie and Sayaka.

events.label: Kataware-doki twilight: timelines meet; braid returned; palms written
events.description: At kataware-doki, the moment of twilight, the two cross the impossible divide and meet on the crater's rim - two times touching at sunset - where she returns the braided cord and they write their names on each other's palms.

events.label: Mitsuha persuades mayor-father to evacuate town
events.description: Mitsuha - back in her own body and time - faces her estranged father, the mayor, and persuades him to order the evacuation.

events.label: Evacuation rewrites comet-disaster outcome
events.description: The town empties up the hill, the comet falls where the town was, and Itomori's eight hundred people live - the disaster rewritten by a girl's stubbornness.

events.label: Memories fade as timelines realign
events.description: As the timelines settle, the miracle drains away: the names they wrote are smudged or missing, and both forget the other - knowing only that someone important is gone.

events.label: Five years later near-amnesiac adults reunite on Suga Shrine steps
events.description: Years later in Tokyo - his five years, her three - two strangers keep feeling for someone they cannot remember, until a passing train and a staircase bring them face to face.

events.label: They ask each other's names
events.description: On the shrine steps, crying without knowing why, they finally ask each other the question the whole story was saving: what is your name?

events.label: Body swaps begin
events.description: The first swap: waking as someone else, in a town neither can place.

events.label: Taki learns 3-year disaster offset
events.description: The reveal of the three-year offset - the day Taki kept trying to reach was three years gone.

events.label: Itomori evacuation succeeds
events.description: The evacuation that saves Itomori - the town's whole history turned by one morning's work.

events.label: Adult name reunion
events.description: The staircase reunion, where two half-memories finally meet.

events.label: Taki/Mitsuha body-swap begins
events.description: Taki and Mitsuha's body-swapping begins - two lives quietly borrowed.

events.label: Comet Tiamat approaches
events.description: The comet Tiamat, returning every twelve hundred years - and about to split.

events.label: Notes / phone diaries across swaps
events.description: The notes and diaries across the swaps - the only way two swapped lives can leave each other instructions.

events.label: Taki realizes Mitsuha's town already destroyed years prior
events.description: Taki's discovery that Mitsuha died three years before they ever met.

events.label: Kataware-doki meet; he gives her ribbon/name
events.description: The twilight meeting on the rim - the braid, the names on palms, and the promise to find each other.

events.label: Mitsuha's side evacuates Itomori
events.description: Mitsuha's side of the save: her body, her town, her father - the evacuation she makes happen.

events.label: Memories fade after save
events.description: The forgetting that follows the save - the price of two timelines realigning.

events.label: Years later stairs reunion
events.description: The years-later reunion on the shrine steps - the film's last, held breath.

ruleEffects.effect: Forced evacuation overwrites Itomori destruction in downstream present
Body-swap knowledge and sake ritual close a guided loop that enables the rewrite

outcome.summary: Body-swap across a three-year offset lets Taki/Mitsuha evacuate Itomori before Comet Tiamat; memories fade then adults reunite asking each other's names.
